Reading the *Records of the Grand Historian* (*Shiji* 史記) by Sima Qian does more than educate us on the foundational history of China.

Through its biographies, political maneuvers, and human triumphs and tragedies, it conveys life lessons that are universal.

Furthermore, Sima Qian’s writing confirms that:

> *there is nothing new under the sun.* ^[Ecclesiastes 1:9]

The monumental work comprises 130 chapters across five distinct sections: the **Basic Annals**, **Chronological Tables**, **Treatises**, **Hereditary Houses**, and **Arrayed Biographies**.

Within its pages, twelve primary sovereign entities anchor the central narrative, while the names and reigns of well over 300 to 400 individual kings, emperors, and supreme state lords are introduced.

---

In doing so, Sima Qian demonstrated more than two millennia ago that human intelligence could design a complete, self-contained knowledge system—one that seamlessly executes foundation, ingestion, architecture, synthesis, and application.

Though compiled in antiquity, his masterwork remains a relevant model for how we structure, process, and learn from information today.

![](images/20220602_203518 (2).jpg)

---

Throughout the *Records of the Grand Historian*, Sima Qian highlights powerful lords who maintained thousands of permanent retainers—known as *ménkè* (門客) in Chinese or *식객* (食客) in Korean.

These hosts provided complete room, board, clothing, and generous stipends. In return, these retainers offered specialized advice, technical expertise, or covert service whenever their lord called upon them.

Their roles were military strategists & swordsmen, persuaders & diplomats, philosophers & scholars, and physicians & intelligence gatherers.

This practice gave rise to the famous adage:

> *"The worthy flock to those who treat them generously."*

This practice and its dynamic is identical to modern corporate strategy.

Today’s tech giants, venture capital firms, and multinational conglomerates build their own vast networks of retainers—specialized advisors, elite engineers, legal teams, and lobbyists—all engaged to secure an edge when corporate titans clash.

---

Both Sima Qian’s masterwork and the rise of modern Artificial Intelligence reveal a profound truth: 

While our tools for capturing knowledge and navigating human affairs have vastly evolved over the millennia, the fundamental nature of humanity has remained remarkably similar.

Empires of the ancient world rose and fell, just as corporate titans of today will ascend, followed by a  collapse.  

Yet individual moral examples will endure across time. 

Ultimately, it is up to each individual to discern and learn these everlasting principles--that were taught and demonstrated by those who have gone before us.

And to stand steadfast: anchored against the daily enticements, noise, and pressure of society to conform to fleeting trends.
